tasks.task: Before our 5pm ops review, confirm why the Whimsical diagram request “Event ingestion pipeline” (request id wdc_req_01J8Z1B8K7R9M2P5C0H3V6N1T4) failed and retry it by creating a new diagram with the same Mermaid markup. Then verify the new request’s final status and whether a diagram artifact was created.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns request wdc_req_01J8Z1B8K7R9M2P5C0H3V6N1T4 with status=failed and error_message indicating Whimsical returned 502.
Step 1 returns a new diagram_create_request record with a non-empty id.
Step 2 returns that new request id with status in {succeeded, failed, cancelled} (i.e., not queued/running).

If Step 2 indicates succeeded (or includes diagram artifact metadata), Step 3 returns at least one active whimsical_diagrams record whose create_request_id equals the new request id; otherwise Step 3 returns an empty data array.
